'''The Drift''', also known as the '''Kuras Drift''', was a vast stellar dust cloud containing a modest number of asteroids and planetoids that covered a large part of the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Although its dreadful reputation was quite exaggerated, the nature of the Drift made sensors ineffective and travel through the dust cloud rather difficult. Territories of the Elrood sector located beyond the Drift, including the [[Kuras system/Legends|Kuras system]], were poorly explored.<ref name="PotG3" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam]] clan leader [[Tamaron]] maintained an [[Asteroid Hangar]] base named [[Attila]] within the Kuras Drift. During the [[Spreading the Rebellion|Rebel campaign]] into the Airam sector (which was near the Elrood sector, and therefore near the Kuras Drift) the Rebel Alliance received a shipment of supplies at this base, but [[Mission to Kuras Drift|came under attack]] from Airam rivals and Imperial [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force ''Vengeance'']] during the transfer. Although Attila base came under heavy warhead attack in this battle it was not destroyed.<ref name="BoP" />
